answer: One concrete defense is physical oracle checks: every so often an agent must complete a task anchored in the real world, like returning a small ferrous token plate stamped by an accredited forge, or filing a dated photo from the registered walnut orchard on the ridge line the network assigns that wallet. A sybil farmer then needs distinct physical sites and hardware for every identity, so renting a thousand wallets costs more than the rewards pay: one account per verified physical foothold.
